qin-unifies-china: Qin Shi Huang becomes the first emperor of a unified China and standardises its script, coins and weights.
fall-of-granada: The last Muslim kingdom in Iberia surrenders to Ferdinand and Isabella, ending the Reconquista.
columbus-reaches-the-americas: Sailing for Spain, Columbus lands in the Bahamas believing he has reached Asia.
battle-of-adwa: Ethiopia defeats an invading Italian army and keeps its independence through the Scramble for Africa.
the-holocaust: Nazi Germany systematically murders six million Jews, along with Roma, disabled people and others.
world-wide-web-proposed: Tim Berners-Lee, working at CERN near Geneva, writes the proposal that becomes the Web.
